line_items.reasoning: Guidance called for revenue down low single digits; North America grew 3% (better than 'modest growth') and while Greater China declined 10% and Converse remained weak, the overall mix — including a February inflection with all North America channels positive — suggests results came in at or slightly better than the low-single-digit decline guided, with North America outperforming expectations.

Guidance called for gross margins down 175–225 bps; actual gross margins declined only 130 bps, meaningfully better than the guided range despite a 300 bps tariff headwind that was close to the guided 315 bps impact.

Guidance called for SG&A dollars up low single digits due to demand creation and sport offense investments; no explicit SG&A figure was reported in the results to indicate a clear deviation, and the $230M severance charge is a separate restructuring item, so SG&A trajectory is treated as roughly in line.

Guidance called for other expense net of interest income to be income of $0–$10M; no explicit figure was reported in the current results to indicate a clear beat or miss, so this is treated as inline.
